actual_scope: Does the complete selected #5413 caller identity hold at every positive column multiplicity, as a checkable certificate in the group algebra of its exact native operators (ports, body, controller)?
scope_change_reason: Target 8 of PR #5428 asks for compact all-width native identity certificates. PR5369/PR5376 settle the selected local provider; the selected result now runs that word inside the #5413 body and 145-axis controller, whose all-width phase argument is prose in WHOLECALLER-PLAN-v1. This package states the lifting lemma and binds it to the actual caller with an executable census.
bottleneck_link: Side result; no new kappa. It discharges the algebraic half of native_all_columns for the selected caller and leaves the physical half (tape realization at width f) explicit.
stop_rule: Stop at the composite certificate of the selected caller; the physical implementation of lifted operators is a separate (direction 10) question.
evidence: verify.py: 896 exact group identities bind every port path to the controller symbols D and C_0 with absolute phase in both orientations (the mixed orientation convention differs on all 112 ports); the free-word body replay with the #5402 provider expanded ends with every warp cancelled and only the port wrappers on main rows; the controller Laurent replay is a free commutative identity realized on 18 disjoint private planes plus the central axis, with C_0^2 = X_0 and C_0^-1 X_0 = C_0 exact; lemma controls on dense Q(i) matrices show the Reynolds and scalar-phase traps pass width 1 and fail width 2. test_verify.py rejects eight mutations.
